term/activation-checkpointing.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/activation-checkpointing.title: Activation Checkpointing
term/activation-checkpointing.description: A training-memory technique that saves only selected forward-pass activations and recomputes the omitted ones during backpropagation.

term/adam-optimizer.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/adam-optimizer.title: Adam (Optimizer)
term/adam-optimizer.description: Adaptive Moment Estimation. It combines an exponential average of gradients with an exponential average of squared gradients, applies bias correction, and adapts the update scale per parameter. It is a useful baseline, but it still needs a suitable learning rate and schedule.

term/adamw.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/adamw.title: AdamW
term/adamw.description: An Adam variant that decouples weight decay from the gradient-based parameter update. That makes the shrinkage behavior easier to reason about than adding an L2 penalty inside Adam's adaptively scaled gradient.

term/admission-control.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/admission-control.title: Admission Control
term/admission-control.description: A pre-acceptance gate that decides whether a request may enter a bounded queue or service under the system's current capacity, priority, and policy.

term/agent.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/agent.title: Agent
term/agent.description: A software system that lets a model select actions toward a goal, observe tool or environment results, and continue under an orchestration policy. An agent may use a loop, a state machine, a workflow engine, or human approvals. The model is one component, not the entire system.

term/agent-harness.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/agent-harness.title: Agent Harness
term/agent-harness.description: The runtime around a model that assembles context, exposes tools, manages state, enforces limits, records traces, and decides when the agent should continue, retry, ask, or stop.

term/agent-memory.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/agent-memory.title: Agent Memory
term/agent-memory.description: Information stored outside the model and selected for use in later agent steps, such as prior decisions, user preferences, task episodes, or verified facts.

term/agent-state.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/agent-state.title: Agent State
term/agent-state.description: The explicit data an agent carries across steps, such as the current objective, completed actions, tool results, open questions, budgets, approvals, and artifact references.

term/agent-skill.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/agent-skill.title: Agent Skill
term/agent-skill.description: A discoverable directory of procedural instructions whose entry point is `SKILL.md`, with optional references, scripts, and assets that a compatible runtime can load in stages.

term/ai-risk-assessment.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/ai-risk-assessment.title: AI Risk Assessment
term/ai-risk-assessment.description: A documented analysis of how an AI system can affect people, organizations, and environments, including context, hazards, likelihood, impact, controls, residual risk, and monitoring responsibilities.

term/alignment.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/alignment.title: Alignment
term/alignment.description: The effort to make a model or AI system behave in ways that match intended goals, constraints, and human preferences across both expected and adversarial situations.

term/approval-gate.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/approval-gate.title: Approval Gate
term/approval-gate.description: A control point that blocks a consequential action until an authorized person or policy grants permission.

term/approximate-nearest-neighbor-ann.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/approximate-nearest-neighbor-ann.title: Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN)
term/approximate-nearest-neighbor-ann.description: A search method that returns vectors likely to be among the nearest to a query without exhaustively comparing the query with every stored vector.

term/attention.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/attention.title: Attention
term/attention.description: A mechanism that forms contextual representations by comparing query vectors with key vectors, normalizing the resulting scores, and using them to combine value vectors. Masks, position rules, or sparse patterns can restrict which positions participate.

term/audio-token.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/audio-token.title: Audio Token
term/audio-token.description: A discrete identifier produced by an audio codec or tokenizer for a short segment or feature of an audio signal, sometimes across several codebooks.

term/audit-log.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/audit-log.title: Audit Log
term/audit-log.description: A durable, access-controlled record of security- or accountability-relevant events, including who or what acted, what changed, when it happened, and the resulting status.

term/automatic-speech-recognition-asr.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/automatic-speech-recognition-asr.title: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
term/automatic-speech-recognition-asr.description: The task and system pipeline that maps a speech signal to a transcription, often with optional token or segment timing and confidence information.

term/autoregressive.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/autoregressive.title: Autoregressive
term/autoregressive.description: A factorization in which each output token is predicted from the tokens that precede it. During generation, the selected token is appended to the sequence and becomes part of the next prediction's context.

term/autoscaling.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/autoscaling.title: Autoscaling
term/autoscaling.description: A control loop that changes the number or capacity of serving workers from observed demand, resource use, or application metrics within configured bounds.

term/availability.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/availability.title: Availability
term/availability.description: The proportion of eligible service interactions or time windows in which users can obtain the defined acceptable service under a stated measurement boundary.

term/backpressure.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/backpressure.title: Backpressure
term/backpressure.description: A flow-control mechanism that slows or rejects upstream work when a downstream component cannot process it safely at the current rate.

term/backpropagation.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/backpropagation.title: Backpropagation
term/backpropagation.description: An efficient application of the chain rule that propagates derivatives from a scalar loss backward through a computation graph. It computes gradients; an optimizer uses those gradients to update parameters.

term/batch-size.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/batch-size.title: Batch Size
term/batch-size.description: The number of examples whose losses contribute to one gradient estimate before an optimizer update. Larger batches can improve hardware utilization and reduce gradient noise, but they require more memory and may need different learning-rate or scheduling choices.

term/benchmark-contamination.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/benchmark-contamination.title: Benchmark Contamination
term/benchmark-contamination.description: Overlap or information leakage between evaluation examples and data used to pretrain, tune, prompt, select, or otherwise improve the evaluated system.

term/bm25.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/bm25.title: BM25
term/bm25.description: A lexical ranking function that scores a document from query-term matches while accounting for term rarity, repeated occurrences, and document length.

term/byte-pair-encoding-bpe.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/byte-pair-encoding-bpe.title: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE)
term/byte-pair-encoding-bpe.description: A subword-tokenization method that repeatedly merges frequent adjacent units to construct a fixed vocabulary from training text.

term/calibration.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/calibration.title: Calibration
term/calibration.description: The agreement between a system's stated confidence and the observed frequency with which predictions at that confidence are correct.

term/canary-release.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/canary-release.title: Canary Release
term/canary-release.description: A deployment strategy that exposes a new version to a limited slice of traffic or infrastructure before expanding the rollout.

term/chain-of-thought-cot.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/chain-of-thought-cot.title: Chain of Thought (CoT)
term/chain-of-thought-cot.description: Intermediate reasoning used to decompose a task before producing an answer. A prompt can request a visible rationale, while some systems use internal reasoning that is not returned to the user.

term/checkpoint.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
term/checkpoint.description: A durable snapshot used to resume from a known boundary. In a workflow, it stores operational state and artifact references. In model training, it can store parameters, optimizer state, scheduler state, and the training position.

term/chunked-prefill.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/chunked-prefill.title: Chunked Prefill
term/chunked-prefill.description: A serving technique that divides a long prompt's prefill work into smaller schedulable pieces so prompt processing can interleave with decode work from other requests.

term/chunking.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/chunking.title: Chunking
term/chunking.description: Dividing source material into retrievable units before indexing. Chunk boundaries, overlap, metadata, and document structure determine whether retrieval returns enough context without flooding the prompt.

term/circuit-breaker.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/circuit-breaker.title: Circuit Breaker
term/circuit-breaker.description: A reliability control that temporarily stops calls to a dependency after failures cross a threshold, then probes whether the dependency has recovered.

term/cnn-convolutional-neural-network.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/cnn-convolutional-neural-network.title: CNN (Convolutional Neural Network)
term/cnn-convolutional-neural-network.description: A neural network that uses convolution operations (sliding filters over the input) to detect local patterns. Stacking convolutions detects increasingly complex features: edges, textures, objects.

term/coding-agent.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/coding-agent.title: Coding Agent
term/coding-agent.description: An agent specialized for software work that can inspect a repository, edit files, run development tools, and use their outputs to advance a scoped engineering task.

term/compensating-action.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/compensating-action.title: Compensating Action
term/compensating-action.description: A deliberate operation that semantically counteracts a completed side effect when the original operation cannot be rolled back atomically.

term/content-provenance.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/content-provenance.title: Content Provenance
term/content-provenance.description: Verifiable information about the origin and editing history of a piece of media or other digital content, including the actors, tools, transformations, and assertions attached to it.

term/context-compression.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/context-compression.title: Context Compression
term/context-compression.description: Reducing the token footprint of source material while attempting to preserve the information required for a later model decision.

term/context-engineering.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/context-engineering.title: Context Engineering
term/context-engineering.description: Designing the full information environment supplied to a model at each step, including instructions, selected files, retrieved evidence, tool results, examples, state, and output constraints.

term/context-window.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/context-window.title: Context Window
term/context-window.description: The maximum token capacity available to one model inference under a specific model and API contract. The capacity may include system instructions, messages, retrieved content, tool exchanges, and generated output, with provider-specific accounting and output limits.

term/continuous-batching.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/continuous-batching.title: Continuous Batching
term/continuous-batching.description: A serving scheduler that adds and removes generation requests at iteration boundaries instead of waiting for every request in a fixed batch to finish.

term/cosine-similarity.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/cosine-similarity.title: Cosine Similarity
term/cosine-similarity.description: The normalized dot product of two vectors. It compares their direction rather than their magnitude and ranges from -1 to 1 for real-valued vectors.

term/cost-per-successful-task.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/cost-per-successful-task.title: Cost per Successful Task
term/cost-per-successful-task.description: Total system cost divided by the number of tasks that satisfy a defined success criterion, including retries, failed runs, tool use, and evaluation overhead.

term/cross-attention.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/cross-attention.title: Cross-Attention
term/cross-attention.description: Attention in which the query representation comes from one sequence or representation while keys and values come from another.

term/cross-entropy.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/cross-entropy.title: Cross-Entropy
term/cross-entropy.description: A loss based on the negative log probability assigned to the target outcome. In next-token training, it penalizes the model when it assigns low probability to the observed next token.

term/cuda.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/cuda.title: CUDA
term/cuda.description: NVIDIA's platform and programming model for general-purpose computation on compatible GPUs. Deep-learning frameworks use CUDA libraries and kernels to execute many tensor operations in parallel.

term/data-augmentation.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/data-augmentation.title: Data Augmentation
term/data-augmentation.description: Creating modified examples, such as transformed images, perturbed audio, or paraphrased text, to increase training diversity without collecting entirely new source data. It can reduce overfitting when the transformation preserves the task signal.

term/data-classification.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/data-classification.title: Data Classification
term/data-classification.description: Assigning data to documented sensitivity or impact classes so handling, access, retention, sharing, and incident rules follow the consequences of disclosure or loss.

term/data-deduplication.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/data-deduplication.title: Data Deduplication
term/data-deduplication.description: Detecting and removing exact and near-duplicate examples within or across datasets.

term/data-exfiltration.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/data-exfiltration.title: Data Exfiltration
term/data-exfiltration.description: Unauthorized transfer of protected data from a system or trust zone to a person, tool, service, or storage location that is not permitted to receive it.

term/data-leakage.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/data-leakage.title: Data Leakage
term/data-leakage.description: Unintended use of information during training or feature construction that would not be available at the real prediction point or belongs to a held-out evaluation boundary.

term/data-lineage.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/data-lineage.title: Data Lineage
term/data-lineage.description: A record of how a data artifact was derived across sources, transformations, joins, filters, versions, and downstream uses.

term/data-minimization.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/data-minimization.title: Data Minimization
term/data-minimization.description: For personal data, limiting what is collected, processed, exposed, and retained to what is necessary for a specified purpose. Teams can apply the same discipline to sensitive non-personal data as an engineering control.

term/data-provenance.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/data-provenance.title: Data Provenance
term/data-provenance.description: Traceable information about where data originated, who or what transformed it, which versions were used, and how derived artifacts relate to their sources.

term/dataset-split.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/dataset-split.title: Dataset Split
term/dataset-split.description: A documented partition of examples into separate subsets for fitting, development decisions, and final evaluation.

term/datasheet-for-datasets.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/datasheet-for-datasets.title: Datasheet for Datasets
term/datasheet-for-datasets.description: Structured documentation of a dataset's motivation, composition, collection process, preprocessing, uses, distribution, maintenance, and known limitations.

term/deadline-propagation.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/deadline-propagation.title: Deadline Propagation
term/deadline-propagation.description: Passing the remaining end-to-end time budget to downstream calls so each dependency knows how long the original request can still usefully wait.

term/decode-phase.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/decode-phase.title: Decode Phase
term/decode-phase.description: The iterative stage of autoregressive inference that generates new tokens one step at a time after the input prefix has been processed.

term/decoding-strategy.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/decoding-strategy.title: Decoding Strategy
term/decoding-strategy.description: The algorithm that converts a model's sequence of next-token scores into selected tokens and a completed output.

term/defense-in-depth.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/defense-in-depth.title: Defense in Depth
term/defense-in-depth.description: Using independent preventive, detective, and corrective controls at several system boundaries so one failed control does not determine the outcome.

term/delegation.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/delegation.title: Delegation
term/delegation.description: Assigning a bounded subtask to another person or agent together with the needed context, authority, output contract, and return conditions.

term/dense-retrieval.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/dense-retrieval.title: Dense Retrieval
term/dense-retrieval.description: First-stage retrieval that embeds queries and candidates into vector representations and ranks candidates by a similarity function.

term/diffusion-model.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/diffusion-model.title: Diffusion Model
term/diffusion-model.description: A generative model trained around a progressive noising process and a learned reverse process. Sampling usually begins from noise and applies repeated denoising steps, sometimes in a learned latent space.

term/disaggregated-serving.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/disaggregated-serving.title: Disaggregated Serving
term/disaggregated-serving.description: A serving architecture that runs prefill and decode work in separately provisioned worker pools and transfers the required attention state between them.

term/distribution-shift.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/distribution-shift.title: Distribution Shift
term/distribution-shift.description: A difference between the data distribution used to build or evaluate a system and the distribution it encounters after deployment.

term/dpo-direct-preference-optimization.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/dpo-direct-preference-optimization.title: DPO (Direct Preference Optimization)
term/dpo-direct-preference-optimization.description: A preference-optimization objective that trains a policy directly from preferred and rejected response pairs relative to a reference policy. It avoids running an explicit reward model and reinforcement-learning loop during this stage.

term/durable-execution.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/durable-execution.title: Durable Execution
term/durable-execution.description: Running a workflow so its state and completed steps survive process crashes, restarts, or long waits without redoing confirmed side effects.

term/dynamic-batching.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/dynamic-batching.title: Dynamic Batching
term/dynamic-batching.description: A runtime policy that forms inference batches from queued requests according to compatible shapes, maximum size, priority, and allowed queue delay.

term/early-fusion.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/early-fusion.title: Early Fusion
term/early-fusion.description: Combining raw or low-level representations from several modalities before most task-specific modeling occurs.

term/embedding.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/embedding.title: Embedding
term/embedding.description: A learned mapping from discrete items (words, images, users) to dense vectors in continuous space, where similar items end up close together

term/encoder.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/encoder.title: Encoder
term/encoder.description: A component that transforms input into a representation. A transformer encoder commonly uses non-causal self-attention, subject to any masks, so each position can incorporate context from across the input.

term/epoch.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/epoch.title: Epoch
term/epoch.description: One traversal of the defined training dataset. In distributed or sampled training, the exact implementation of an epoch depends on the data loader and sampling policy.

term/error-budget.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/error-budget.title: Error Budget
term/error-budget.description: The amount of unsuccessful service allowed by a service-level objective over its measurement window before the objective is exhausted.

term/eval-set.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/eval-set.title: Eval Set
term/eval-set.description: A versioned collection of inputs, expected properties, scoring rules, and metadata used to measure an AI system against a defined capability or risk.

term/evaluation-eval.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/evaluation-eval.title: Evaluation (Eval)
term/evaluation-eval.description: A defined process for measuring model or system behavior on representative tasks using explicit success criteria, data, scorers, and review procedures.

term/exact-match-em.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/exact-match-em.title: Exact Match (EM)
term/exact-match-em.description: A metric that counts an output as correct only when its normalized representation exactly equals an accepted reference answer.

term/expert-parallelism.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/expert-parallelism.title: Expert Parallelism
term/expert-parallelism.description: Distributing mixture-of-experts subnetworks across devices and routing each token's activations to the devices that host its selected experts.

term/feature.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/feature.title: Feature
term/feature.description: An individual measurable property of the data. In classical ML, you engineer features by hand. In deep learning, the network learns features automatically from raw data.

term/few-shot.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/few-shot.title: Few-Shot
term/few-shot.description: In-context learning that includes a small set of demonstrations before the target input so the model can infer the desired task, format, or decision boundary.

term/fine-tuning.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/fine-tuning.title: Fine-tuning
term/fine-tuning.description: Continuing training from pretrained parameters on a narrower dataset or objective. Depending on the method, you may update all parameters, selected parameters, or added adapter parameters.

term/flaky-test.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/flaky-test.title: Flaky Test
term/flaky-test.description: A test that can pass and fail across equivalent runs without a relevant change to the code or intended test environment.

term/flashattention.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/flashattention.title: FlashAttention
term/flashattention.description: An exact attention algorithm that tiles the computation to reduce transfers between accelerator memory levels while avoiding materialization of the full attention matrix in high-bandwidth memory.

term/function-calling.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/function-calling.title: Function Calling
term/function-calling.description: A provider or application interface through which a model emits a structured request naming a tool and its arguments. Application code validates the request, performs the operation, and can return the result for another model step.

term/goodput.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/goodput.title: Goodput
term/goodput.description: The rate of completed requests that satisfy defined service constraints, such as both time-to-first-token and per-token latency objectives, under a stated workload.

term/graceful-degradation.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/graceful-degradation.title: Graceful Degradation
term/graceful-degradation.description: Preserving a bounded core service when capacity or dependencies are impaired by reducing optional quality, features, freshness, or workload instead of failing every request.

term/gradient.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/gradient.title: Gradient
term/gradient.description: A vector of partial derivatives pointing in the direction of steepest increase. In ML, you go opposite to the gradient (gradient descent) to minimize the loss.

term/gradient-accumulation.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/gradient-accumulation.title: Gradient Accumulation
term/gradient-accumulation.description: Summing or averaging gradients from several microbatches before performing one optimizer update.

term/gradient-clipping.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/gradient-clipping.title: Gradient Clipping
term/gradient-clipping.description: Limiting gradient values or their combined norm before an optimizer update when they exceed a chosen threshold.

term/grounding.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/grounding.title: Grounding
term/grounding.description: Connecting a generated answer or action to evidence, state, or observations that the system can identify and check.

term/guardrails.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/guardrails.title: Guardrails
term/guardrails.description: System controls that constrain inputs, tool use, outputs, permissions, and escalation. They can include schemas, policy checks, classifiers, allowlists, sandboxing, approvals, and post-action verification.

term/hallucination.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/hallucination.title: Hallucination
term/hallucination.description: Generated content that is false, unsupported by the available evidence, or inconsistent with the task's source of truth. It can arise even when the output is fluent and the model is not attempting to deceive.

term/handoff.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/handoff.title: Handoff
term/handoff.description: A structured transfer of a task between people or agents that preserves the objective, current state, evidence, decisions, constraints, and remaining work.

term/hnsw.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/hnsw.title: HNSW
term/hnsw.description: An approximate-nearest-neighbor index that organizes vectors in layered proximity graphs and searches from coarse upper layers toward detailed lower layers.

term/human-in-the-loop-hitl.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/human-in-the-loop-hitl.title: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)
term/human-in-the-loop-hitl.description: A workflow design in which a person supplies judgment, correction, approval, or escalation at defined points in an AI-driven process.

term/hybrid-retrieval.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/hybrid-retrieval.title: Hybrid Retrieval
term/hybrid-retrieval.description: Retrieval that combines signals from different methods, commonly lexical matching and dense-vector similarity, before merging or reranking results.

term/hyperparameter.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/hyperparameter.title: Hyperparameter
term/hyperparameter.description: A configuration choice that shapes model structure, optimization, data processing, or inference rather than being learned as an ordinary model parameter. Examples include learning rate, batch size, layer count, and decoding settings.

term/idempotency.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/idempotency.title: Idempotency
term/idempotency.description: The property that repeating the same operation with the same identity does not create additional side effects beyond the first successful application.

term/image-token.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/image-token.title: Image Token
term/image-token.description: A model-specific visual unit represented as a vector or discrete code, commonly derived from an image patch, region, or learned visual-codebook entry.

term/in-context-learning.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/in-context-learning.title: In-Context Learning
term/in-context-learning.description: A model adapting its behavior from instructions, examples, or patterns supplied in the current input without an ordinary parameter update.

term/incident-response.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/incident-response.title: Incident Response
term/incident-response.description: The coordinated process for detecting, analyzing, containing, recovering from, communicating, and learning from an event that threatens service, data, safety, or security.

term/indirect-prompt-injection.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/indirect-prompt-injection.title: Indirect Prompt Injection
term/indirect-prompt-injection.description: A prompt-injection attack delivered through content the system retrieves or observes, such as a webpage, document, email, image text, or tool result, rather than directly through the user's instruction.

term/inductive-bias.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/inductive-bias.title: Inductive Bias
term/inductive-bias.description: Structural or statistical assumptions that favor some functions or representations over others. Convolution favors locality and shared filters; causal masking favors prediction from preceding positions.

term/inference.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/inference.title: Inference
term/inference.description: Executing a trained model to produce predictions, scores, embeddings, or generated tokens without performing an ordinary training update to its parameters.

term/instruction-following.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/instruction-following.title: Instruction Following
term/instruction-following.description: A model capability to map natural-language directions and supplied context to behavior that satisfies the stated task and constraints.

term/instruction-hierarchy.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/instruction-hierarchy.title: Instruction Hierarchy
term/instruction-hierarchy.description: A rule set for resolving conflicts among instructions from sources with different authority, such as application policy, users, and untrusted retrieved content.

term/inter-token-latency-itl.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/inter-token-latency-itl.title: Inter-Token Latency (ITL)
term/inter-token-latency-itl.description: The elapsed time between two consecutive output-token arrival events for one request, calculated as `t_i - t_(i-1)` for an output token after the first.

term/jailbreak.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/jailbreak.title: Jailbreak
term/jailbreak.description: An adversarial input or interaction strategy intended to make a model produce behavior that its training or application controls are designed to prevent.

term/jax.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/jax.title: JAX
term/jax.description: A Python library for transforming numerical functions with automatic differentiation, compilation, vectorization, and parallel execution across accelerators. Its transformations work best with explicit state and functional-style code.

term/knowledge-distillation.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/knowledge-distillation.title: Knowledge Distillation
term/knowledge-distillation.description: Training a student model to reproduce selected behavior or output distributions from a more capable teacher, often alongside ordinary target labels.

term/kv-cache.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/kv-cache.title: KV Cache
term/kv-cache.description: Stored key and value tensors from earlier positions in autoregressive generation. Reusing them avoids recomputing attention projections for the unchanged prefix at every decoding step.

term/late-fusion.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/late-fusion.title: Late Fusion
term/late-fusion.description: Processing modalities through separate encoders or predictors and combining their high-level representations, scores, or decisions near the task output.

term/latent-space.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/latent-space.title: Latent Space
term/latent-space.description: A learned representation space whose coordinates encode factors useful to a model. It may be lower-dimensional than the input, but compression is not required for every latent representation.

term/learning-rate.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/learning-rate.title: Learning Rate
term/learning-rate.description: A scale factor used by an optimizer to control parameter-update magnitude. Values that are too large can destabilize training; values that are too small can make useful progress impractically slow.

term/learning-rate-schedule.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/learning-rate-schedule.title: Learning Rate Schedule
term/learning-rate-schedule.description: A policy that changes the optimizer's learning rate as training progresses according to steps, epochs, metrics, or a predefined curve.

term/least-privilege.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/least-privilege.title: Least Privilege
term/least-privilege.description: Giving a model, agent, tool, or user only the permissions required for the current task, for only as long as those permissions are needed.

term/llm-large-language-model.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/llm-large-language-model.title: LLM (Large Language Model)
term/llm-large-language-model.description: A language model with enough capacity and broad training to perform many language tasks through prompting or adaptation. Most current LLMs use transformer architectures and sequence-prediction objectives, but size thresholds, data sources, and training recipes vary.

term/llm-as-a-judge.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/llm-as-a-judge.title: LLM-as-a-Judge
term/llm-as-a-judge.description: Using a language model to score, compare, classify, or critique another system's output against a rubric.

term/load-shedding.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/load-shedding.title: Load Shedding
term/load-shedding.description: Deliberately rejecting, dropping, or cancelling selected work at one or more overload boundaries when demand exceeds the capacity available to produce useful results.

term/logits.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/logits.title: Logits
term/logits.description: The model's unnormalized numeric scores for candidate outcomes before a normalization function or decoding rule converts them into selections.

term/lora-low-rank-adaptation.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/lora-low-rank-adaptation.title: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation)
term/lora-low-rank-adaptation.description: A method that keeps base weights frozen and learns low-rank update matrices for selected layers. It reduces the number of trainable parameters and can lower training memory relative to full-parameter fine-tuning.

term/loss-function.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/loss-function.title: Loss Function
term/loss-function.description: An objective that maps predictions and targets, sometimes with regularization terms, to a value optimization tries to reduce. The loss determines which errors training directly rewards or penalizes.

term/lost-in-the-middle.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/lost-in-the-middle.title: Lost in the Middle
term/lost-in-the-middle.description: A long-context failure pattern in which model performance changes with evidence position and can degrade when relevant information sits between the beginning and end.

term/maximum-marginal-relevance-mmr.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/maximum-marginal-relevance-mmr.title: Maximum Marginal Relevance (MMR)
term/maximum-marginal-relevance-mmr.description: A selection rule that balances relevance to the query with novelty relative to items already selected.

term/mcp-model-context-protocol.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/mcp-model-context-protocol.title: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
term/mcp-model-context-protocol.description: An open JSON-RPC protocol for a host to connect to servers that expose tools, resources, prompts, and extensions through defined request, result, discovery, and transport contracts. In revision 2026-07-28, every request carries its protocol version and client capabilities instead of relying on an initialization handshake or protocol session.

term/membership-inference.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/membership-inference.title: Membership Inference
term/membership-inference.description: An attack that estimates whether a particular record or example was included in a model's training data by observing model outputs or other accessible signals.

term/mixed-precision.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/mixed-precision.title: Mixed Precision
term/mixed-precision.description: A numerical strategy that uses different data types for different operations, often lower precision for many matrix operations and higher precision for values that need more range or stability.

term/modality.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/modality.title: Modality
term/modality.description: A form of information with its own structure and acquisition process, such as text, image, audio, video, depth, or sensor measurements.

term/modality-alignment.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/modality-alignment.title: Modality Alignment
term/modality-alignment.description: Learning or establishing correspondences between representations from different modalities so semantically or temporally related items can be matched.

term/model-card.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/model-card.title: Model Card
term/model-card.description: A structured report describing a model's intended uses, evaluation conditions, performance characteristics, limitations, and relevant ethical or safety considerations.

term/model-router.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/model-router.title: Model Router
term/model-router.description: A component that selects a model or provider for a request using requirements such as capability, latency, cost, context size, policy, and current availability.

term/model-serving.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/model-serving.title: Model Serving
term/model-serving.description: The runtime and API layer that loads versioned model artifacts, accepts inference requests, schedules execution, manages resources, and returns results under an operational contract.

term/moe-mixture-of-experts.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/moe-mixture-of-experts.title: MoE (Mixture of Experts)
term/moe-mixture-of-experts.description: An architecture with multiple expert subnetworks and a learned router that selects a subset for each input unit, often each token. Sparse activation can increase total parameter capacity without using every expert on every forward pass.

term/multimodal-fusion.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/multimodal-fusion.title: Multimodal Fusion
term/multimodal-fusion.description: Combining evidence or learned representations from more than one modality to produce a joint representation, prediction, or generated output.

term/multimodal-model.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/multimodal-model.title: Multimodal Model
term/multimodal-model.description: A model that learns from, relates, or generates more than one modality through representation, alignment, fusion, translation, or coordinated prediction.

term/multi-round-trip-request-mrtr.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/multi-round-trip-request-mrtr.title: Multi Round-Trip Request (MRTR)
term/multi-round-trip-request-mrtr.description: An MCP request pattern in which an operation returns `resultType: input_required` with one or more `inputRequests`, then the client retries the original method with `inputResponses` and the exact returned `requestState`.

term/nan-not-a-number.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/nan-not-a-number.title: NaN (Not a Number)
term/nan-not-a-number.description: A floating-point value representing an undefined or unrepresentable numerical result. In training, NaNs can come from invalid operations, overflow, unstable normalization, excessive updates, or earlier corrupted values.

term/normalization.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/normalization.title: Normalization
term/normalization.description: A family of transformations that rescale or recenter inputs, activations, or features using defined statistics. Batch normalization and layer normalization use different axes and behave differently across training and inference.

term/nucleus-sampling-top-p.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/nucleus-sampling-top-p.title: Nucleus Sampling (Top-p)
term/nucleus-sampling-top-p.description: A decoding method that samples from the smallest set of next-token candidates whose cumulative probability reaches a chosen threshold.

term/observability.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/observability.title: Observability
term/observability.description: The ability to understand an AI system's behavior from recorded inputs, outputs, state transitions, tool calls, timings, costs, errors, and evaluation signals.

term/optimizer.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/optimizer.title: Optimizer
term/optimizer.description: An algorithm that transforms gradients into parameter updates. Plain stochastic gradient descent is a simple baseline; momentum, Adam, and other optimizers change the update using history or adaptive scaling. Each choice has different memory, stability, and tuning behavior.

term/orchestration.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/orchestration.title: Orchestration
term/orchestration.description: The control logic that sequences, branches, delegates, retries, pauses, resumes, and terminates work across model and tool steps.

term/overfitting.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/overfitting.title: Overfitting
term/overfitting.description: A generalization gap in which performance on training data is substantially better than performance on representative unseen data. Memorization can contribute, but the operational symptom is poor generalization.

term/paged-kv-cache.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/paged-kv-cache.title: Paged KV Cache
term/paged-kv-cache.description: A KV-cache memory manager that stores attention state in fixed-size blocks and maps logical sequence positions to physical blocks instead of requiring one contiguous allocation per sequence.

term/parameter.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/parameter.title: Parameter
term/parameter.description: A value learned during training, commonly a weight, bias, embedding element, or normalization parameter. Parameter count is one measure of model capacity, but it does not directly determine quality, memory, or serving cost.

term/pass-k.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/pass-k.title: Pass@k
term/pass-k.description: Across a task set, the fraction of tasks for which at least one of k sampled candidates passes a defined correctness test.

term/patch.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/patch.title: Patch
term/patch.description: A reviewable representation of changes to one or more files, usually expressed as additions and deletions against a known base revision.

term/patch-embedding.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/patch-embedding.title: Patch Embedding
term/patch-embedding.description: A learned projection that converts an image patch into a fixed-width vector used as one element of a transformer input sequence.

term/perplexity.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/perplexity.title: Perplexity
term/perplexity.description: The exponentiated average negative log-likelihood under a stated tokenization and logarithm convention. Lower values mean the model assigned higher probability to the evaluated sequence.

term/pipeline-parallelism.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/pipeline-parallelism.title: Pipeline Parallelism
term/pipeline-parallelism.description: Partitioning sequential groups of model layers across devices and moving microbatches or requests through those stages as a pipeline.

term/planning.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/planning.title: Planning
term/planning.description: Constructing, selecting, or revising a sequence of actions and dependencies intended to move from the current state to a goal.

term/postmortem.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/postmortem.title: Postmortem
term/postmortem.description: A durable incident record that explains impact, detection, response, contributing conditions, recovery, and owned follow-up actions without assigning blame as a substitute for analysis.

term/precision-recall.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/precision-recall.title: Precision & Recall
term/precision-recall.description: Precision asks how many flagged items were correct; recall asks how many relevant items were found. When you change the decision threshold for one fixed scoring model, improving recall often lowers precision and vice versa. A better model can improve both. F1 is their harmonic mean.

term/prefill.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/prefill.title: Prefill
term/prefill.description: The initial inference stage that processes all supplied input tokens to produce their representations and the attention state required for subsequent autoregressive generation.

term/prefix-caching.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/prefix-caching.title: Prefix Caching
term/prefix-caching.description: Reusing KV-cache blocks produced for an identical eligible token prefix across requests so the serving runtime can skip repeated prefix computation.

term/progressive-disclosure.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/progressive-disclosure.title: Progressive Disclosure
term/progressive-disclosure.description: Supplying a person or model with the minimum useful context first, then revealing deeper detail when the task or evidence requires it.

term/prompt-cache.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/prompt-cache.title: Prompt Cache
term/prompt-cache.description: Reuse of provider-side or application-side computation for an identical or eligible prompt prefix so repeated inference avoids some preprocessing work.

term/prompt-injection.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/prompt-injection.title: Prompt Injection
term/prompt-injection.description: An attack or failure mode in which untrusted content influences a model to disregard intended instructions, expose data, misuse tools, or take actions outside the user's goal. The content can arrive directly from a user or indirectly through retrieved pages, files, messages, or tool output.

term/prompt-sensitivity.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/prompt-sensitivity.title: Prompt Sensitivity
term/prompt-sensitivity.description: Variation in model output or measured performance caused by changes to prompt wording, order, formatting, or examples that preserve the intended task.

term/provenance-attestation.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/provenance-attestation.title: Provenance Attestation
term/provenance-attestation.description: Authenticated, machine-readable metadata that binds an artifact to claims about how, where, when, and from which inputs it was produced.

term/purpose-limitation.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/purpose-limitation.title: Purpose Limitation
term/purpose-limitation.description: For personal data, collecting and using it only for specified, explicit purposes unless a new use has an appropriate compatible or authorized basis.

term/qlora.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/qlora.title: QLoRA
term/qlora.description: A parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that keeps a pretrained base model frozen in a low-bit quantized representation while training LoRA adapters with higher-precision computation where needed.

term/quantization.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/quantization.title: Quantization
term/quantization.description: Representing weights, activations, or caches with lower-precision formats to reduce memory, bandwidth, or compute cost. Methods differ in calibration, granularity, data type, and whether conversion happens before, during, or after training.

term/rag-retrieval-augmented-generation.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/rag-retrieval-augmented-generation.title: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
term/rag-retrieval-augmented-generation.description: A system pattern that retrieves evidence relevant to a request and supplies selected content to a generative model before it answers or acts. Retrieval can use lexical, vector, structured, or hybrid methods.

term/rate-limit.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/rate-limit.title: Rate Limit
term/rate-limit.description: A policy that caps requests, tokens, concurrent work, or another resource within a defined time or capacity window.

term/react.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/react.title: ReAct
term/react.description: An agent pattern that interleaves task reasoning, a concrete action, and an observation returned by the environment before deciding the next step.

term/readiness-probe.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/readiness-probe.title: Readiness Probe
term/readiness-probe.description: A diagnostic that tells the traffic-routing layer whether a service instance is currently able to accept requests.

term/recall-k.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/recall-k.title: Recall@K
term/recall-k.description: For one query, Recall@K is `|relevant items intersecting the top k| / |relevant items|`. A dataset score aggregates those per-query values under a stated rule.

term/reciprocal-rank-fusion-rrf.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/reciprocal-rank-fusion-rrf.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)
term/reciprocal-rank-fusion-rrf.description: A rank-fusion method that combines several result lists by summing contributions that decrease with each item's rank in each list.

term/red-teaming.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/red-teaming.title: Red Teaming
term/red-teaming.description: A structured adversarial testing process in which authorized testers seek failures using documented objectives, threat assumptions, cases, and evidence.

term/regression-test.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/regression-test.title: Regression Test
term/regression-test.description: A repeatable check that protects behavior known to work, especially after code, prompt, model, retrieval, or tool changes.

term/repository-instructions.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/repository-instructions.title: Repository Instructions
term/repository-instructions.description: Version-controlled guidance that tells coding agents how a repository is organized, which commands and conventions apply, what boundaries to respect, and how to verify work.

term/repository-map.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/repository-map.title: Repository Map
term/repository-map.description: A compact, maintained description of a repository's important directories, ownership boundaries, entry points, build commands, tests, generated files, and local instructions.

term/reproducible-build.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/reproducible-build.title: Reproducible Build
term/reproducible-build.description: A build whose declared source, environment, and instructions can be independently rerun to produce bit-for-bit identical specified artifacts.

term/reranker.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/reranker.title: Reranker
term/reranker.description: A second-stage model or scoring function that reorders a small candidate set using a richer comparison between the query and each candidate.

term/retry-budget.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/retry-budget.title: Retry Budget
term/retry-budget.description: A bound on retry traffic, usually expressed relative to original requests or over a time window, that prevents retries from consuming unbounded capacity.

term/retry-with-backoff.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/retry-with-backoff.title: Retry with Backoff
term/retry-with-backoff.description: Repeating a failed transient operation after progressively longer delays, usually with randomized jitter and a strict retry limit.

term/reviewer-agent.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/reviewer-agent.title: Reviewer Agent
term/reviewer-agent.description: An agent assigned to inspect another agent's artifact or decision against explicit criteria and return findings or a verdict.

term/rlhf-reinforcement-learning-from-hu.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/rlhf-reinforcement-learning-from-hu.title: RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback)
term/rlhf-reinforcement-learning-from-hu.description: A family of pipelines that uses human feedback to learn a reward or preference signal and then optimizes a model policy against that signal. Implementations vary and need not all use the same reinforcement-learning algorithm.

term/rollback.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/rollback.title: Rollback
term/rollback.description: Restoring a previously known deployment or configuration when the current release violates operational, quality, or safety criteria.

term/rouge.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/rouge.title: ROUGE
term/rouge.description: A family of metrics that compares generated text with reference text using units such as n-gram overlap or longest common subsequence.

term/sandbox.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/sandbox.title: Sandbox
term/sandbox.description: An isolated execution environment that restricts an agent's access to files, processes, network destinations, credentials, and host resources.

term/saturation.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/saturation.title: Saturation
term/saturation.description: The degree to which a constrained resource or service has exhausted its capacity, including queued work that cannot begin promptly.

term/scope-contract.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/scope-contract.title: Scope Contract
term/scope-contract.description: A concrete agreement that defines a task's goal, allowed and forbidden surfaces, expected artifacts, verification requirements, and stopping conditions.

term/self-attention.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/self-attention.title: Self-Attention
term/self-attention.description: Attention in which queries, keys, and values are derived from the same sequence representation. Scaled similarity scores are normalized and used to combine values, subject to causal, padding, local, or other masks.

term/semantic-cache.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/semantic-cache.title: Semantic Cache
term/semantic-cache.description: A cache that reuses a previous result when a new request is judged sufficiently similar under a chosen representation and threshold.

term/semantic-search.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/semantic-search.title: Semantic Search
term/semantic-search.description: Retrieval that represents a query and candidates in an embedding space and ranks candidates using a vector-similarity function.

term/separation-of-duties.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/separation-of-duties.title: Separation of Duties
term/separation-of-duties.description: Dividing conflicting responsibilities or authority across independent roles so one principal cannot complete a high-risk action without another authorized decision.

term/service-level-indicator-sli.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/service-level-indicator-sli.title: Service Level Indicator (SLI)
term/service-level-indicator-sli.description: A quantitative measure of service behavior at a defined user-relevant boundary, such as successful request ratio or latency below a threshold.

term/service-level-objective-slo.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/service-level-objective-slo.title: Service Level Objective (SLO)
term/service-level-objective-slo.description: A target range or threshold for a service-level indicator over a stated population and measurement window.

term/sft-supervised-fine-tuning.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/sft-supervised-fine-tuning.title: SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning)
term/sft-supervised-fine-tuning.description: Fine-tuning a pretrained model on paired inputs and desired responses so it learns the demonstrated behavior under the training distribution.

term/shadow-traffic.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/shadow-traffic.title: Shadow Traffic
term/shadow-traffic.description: A copy of live request traffic sent to a candidate system for observation while the candidate response remains outside the primary user response path. Because the copied request still executes, its side effects must be isolated.

term/shared-embedding-space.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/shared-embedding-space.title: Shared Embedding Space
term/shared-embedding-space.description: A common vector space in which representations from different modalities can be compared with the same similarity function.

term/skill-bundle.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/skill-bundle.title: Skill Bundle
term/skill-bundle.description: The complete installable skill directory, including `SKILL.md` and every reference, script, asset, fixture, or companion file required by the workflow.

term/skill-catalog.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/skill-catalog.title: Skill Catalog
term/skill-catalog.description: The compact model-visible inventory of eligible skills, usually containing routing metadata such as name, description, and an internal source identifier rather than every skill body.

term/skill-discovery.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/skill-discovery.title: Skill Discovery
term/skill-discovery.description: A runtime pipeline that searches configured roots, identifies candidate skill directories, validates their package contract, attaches scope and provenance, resolves collisions, and publishes eligible catalog entries.

term/skill-invocation.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/skill-invocation.title: Skill Invocation
term/skill-invocation.description: The runtime-mediated process in which an eligible human, model, application, or other skill selects a skill and causes its instructions to enter the working context.

term/softmax.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/softmax.title: Softmax
term/softmax.description: A function defined by `softmax(x_i) = exp(x_i) / sum(exp(x_j))`, implemented with numerical stabilization. Its outputs are positive and sum to one, so they can parameterize a categorical distribution.

term/software-bill-of-materials-sbom.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/software-bill-of-materials-sbom.title: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)
term/software-bill-of-materials-sbom.description: A structured inventory of software components and relationships associated with a product or artifact, often including versions, suppliers, licenses, and identifiers.

term/speculative-decoding.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/speculative-decoding.title: Speculative Decoding
term/speculative-decoding.description: An inference method in which a cheaper draft process proposes several tokens and the target model scores those draft positions in parallel. In exact sampling variants, an acceptance and correction rule preserves the target model's output distribution.

term/stateless-mcp.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/stateless-mcp.title: Stateless MCP
term/stateless-mcp.description: The MCP 2026-07-28 request model in which every request carries the protocol version and client capabilities in `params._meta`, while results carry an explicit `resultType`; no protocol state is keyed by an initialization handshake, connection, or `Mcp-Session-Id`.

term/stochastic-gradient-descent-sgd.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/stochastic-gradient-descent-sgd.title: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD)
term/stochastic-gradient-descent-sgd.description: An optimizer family that updates parameters from a gradient estimated on a sampled example or minibatch rather than the complete training dataset.

term/stop-sequence.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/stop-sequence.title: Stop Sequence
term/stop-sequence.description: An application-specified token or text pattern that causes generation to stop when the decoding system encounters it.

term/streaming.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/streaming.title: Streaming
term/streaming.description: Delivering incremental response events before the complete result is ready. A stream may contain token text, structured deltas, tool-call arguments, usage metadata, or status events depending on the API.

term/structured-output.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/structured-output.title: Structured Output
term/structured-output.description: Model output constrained or validated against a machine-readable schema so application code can consume fields without parsing free-form prose.

term/swarm.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/swarm.title: Swarm
term/swarm.description: A loosely coordinated multi-agent pattern in which local agent decisions and message exchange produce system-level behavior. The term is used inconsistently, so the actual topology, state ownership, and termination rules must be specified.

term/system-prompt.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/system-prompt.title: System Prompt
term/system-prompt.description: A provider-defined instruction message or configuration supplied by the application to establish behavior and constraints within that provider's instruction hierarchy.

term/tail-latency.label: Glossary term · Reliability & operations
term/tail-latency.title: Tail Latency
term/tail-latency.description: The latency experienced by the slowest portion of requests, commonly summarized with a high percentile under a stated workload and time window.

term/temperature.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/temperature.title: Temperature
term/temperature.description: A decoding parameter that rescales logits before a probability distribution is formed. Higher positive values usually flatten the distribution; lower positive values sharpen it.

term/tensor-parallelism.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/tensor-parallelism.title: Tensor Parallelism
term/tensor-parallelism.description: Partitioning tensor operations within a model layer across devices, with collective communication combining partial results during the layer computation.

term/termination-condition.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/termination-condition.title: Termination Condition
term/termination-condition.description: An explicit rule that ends or pauses an agent run when it succeeds, fails, exhausts a budget, reaches a safe boundary, or requires escalation.

term/test-oracle.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/test-oracle.title: Test Oracle
term/test-oracle.description: The mechanism, specification, reference, invariant, or human judgment used to decide whether observed program behavior is correct.

term/threat-model.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/threat-model.title: Threat Model
term/threat-model.description: A documented account of protected assets, trust boundaries, potential adversaries, assumed capabilities, attack paths, impacts, and planned controls.

term/time-per-output-token-tpot.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/time-per-output-token-tpot.title: Time per Output Token (TPOT)
term/time-per-output-token-tpot.description: For one request with `N > 1` output tokens, the average post-first-token interval: `(t_N - t_1) / (N - 1)`. System distributions then aggregate those per-request averages.

term/time-to-first-token-ttft.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/time-to-first-token-ttft.title: Time to First Token (TTFT)
term/time-to-first-token-ttft.description: The elapsed time from submitting a generation request until the client receives the first output token or content event under a defined measurement boundary.

term/token.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/token.title: Token
term/token.description: An integer identifier produced by a model-specific tokenizer from text, bytes, images, audio, or another input representation. A token can be a whole word, part of a word, punctuation, whitespace, a byte sequence, or a special control symbol.

term/token-budget.label: Glossary term · Prompting & context
term/token-budget.title: Token Budget
term/token-budget.description: An explicit allocation of token capacity across instructions, evidence, history, tool results, reasoning or working space, and output.

term/tokenization.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/tokenization.title: Tokenization
term/tokenization.description: Converting an input representation into the ordered token identifiers a specific model or tokenizer accepts.

term/tokens-per-second-tps.label: Glossary term · Infrastructure & serving
term/tokens-per-second-tps.title: Tokens per Second (TPS)
term/tokens-per-second-tps.description: A throughput measure reporting how many output tokens a serving system produces per unit time under a stated scope and workload.

term/tool-contract.label: Glossary term · Agents & tools
term/tool-contract.title: Tool Contract
term/tool-contract.description: The complete agreement for a tool boundary: purpose, typed inputs, outputs, validation, permissions, side effects, errors, timeouts, idempotency, and evidence returned to the caller.

term/top-k-sampling.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/top-k-sampling.title: Top-k Sampling
term/top-k-sampling.description: A decoding method that restricts the next-token distribution to the k highest-scoring candidates, renormalizes their probabilities, and samples from that set.

term/trace.label: Glossary term · AI-native development
term/trace.title: Trace
term/trace.description: A correlated record of one request or task across model calls, retrieval, tools, state transitions, retries, approvals, and evaluations.

term/transfer-learning.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/transfer-learning.title: Transfer Learning
term/transfer-learning.description: Starting from representations or parameters learned on one data distribution or objective and adapting them for another. The transferable components and update strategy depend on architecture and task.

term/transformer.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/transformer.title: Transformer
term/transformer.description: A neural-network architecture built from attention, position information, feed-forward sublayers, residual connections, and normalization. Encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder variants use different masks and information flows.

term/trust-boundary.label: Glossary term · Security & governance
term/trust-boundary.title: Trust Boundary
term/trust-boundary.description: An interface where data, instructions, identity, or authority crosses between components or principals that operate under different trust assumptions.

term/underfitting.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/underfitting.title: Underfitting
term/underfitting.description: A model or training setup has insufficient effective capacity, optimization, features, or training signal to capture useful patterns in the training data.

term/vae-variational-autoencoder.label: Glossary term · Models & inference
term/vae-variational-autoencoder.title: VAE (Variational Autoencoder)
term/vae-variational-autoencoder.description: A latent-variable model trained with a reconstruction objective and a regularization term that keeps an approximate posterior close to a chosen prior. The reparameterization estimator allows gradients through stochastic latent sampling.

term/vector-database.label: Glossary term · Retrieval & generation
term/vector-database.title: Vector Database
term/vector-database.description: A storage and indexing system that supports nearest-neighbor queries over vector representations, often with metadata filtering, persistence, and approximate indexes.

term/verification-gate.label: Glossary term · Evaluation & safety
term/verification-gate.title: Verification Gate
term/verification-gate.description: A control point that blocks progress until defined evidence satisfies a correctness or quality criterion.

term/vision-language-model-vlm.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/vision-language-model-vlm.title: Vision-Language Model (VLM)
term/vision-language-model-vlm.description: A model that learns relationships between, or jointly processes, visual and language representations for tasks such as retrieval, description, question answering, or grounded generation.

term/vision-transformer-vit.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/vision-transformer-vit.title: Vision Transformer (ViT)
term/vision-transformer-vit.description: A vision architecture that represents an image as a sequence of patch embeddings with position information and processes that sequence with transformer encoder blocks.

term/visual-grounding.label: Glossary term · Multimodal systems
term/visual-grounding.title: Visual Grounding
term/visual-grounding.description: Connecting a language expression to spatial evidence in an image or video, such as a region, object, mask, or tracked entity.

term/vocabulary.label: Glossary term · Data & representations
term/vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
term/vocabulary.description: The finite mapping between token identifiers and the units a tokenizer can emit, including ordinary, byte-level, and special control tokens.

term/warmup.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/warmup.title: Warmup
term/warmup.description: An initial training phase in which the learning rate rises from a smaller value toward the main schedule's target value.

term/weight.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/weight.title: Weight
term/weight.description: A trainable coefficient in a model transformation. Weights are usually organized into tensors, and optimization adjusts them to reduce the training objective.

term/weight-decay.label: Glossary term · Math & training
term/weight-decay.title: Weight Decay
term/weight-decay.description: An update rule that reduces selected parameter magnitudes over training, often by multiplying weights by a shrinkage factor separate from the gradient update.
